svg.text: DEVELOPER SALES PLAYBOOK | WORKBOOK WB C38-X · P. 100
See why a strong opportunity can still be unready when one critical dimension is missing.

g.text: Problem, importance, solution, scope, economics, decision authority, stakeholders,
timing, and mutual commitment all sufficiently clear. Proposal Ready.
Problem/importance only partial; solution/scope unknown; implementation proposal would
be guessed. Offer paid discovery if worth pursuing.
Problem and solution strong, but decision authority = 0 and stakeholder clarity partial.
Bring the economic buyer into the process before a detailed proposal.

svg.text: RESOLVE THE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL MISSING DIMENSION FIRST
Do not mechanically “raise the score.” Ask which unknown can invalidate the whole opportunity.
Missing decision authority or unknown integration feasibility may matter more than a small scope detail.
